title: MODY 사용자 지표

panels.title: DAU (오늘)
panels.description: 오늘(한국시간) 식사·운동 기록, 챌린지 인증, 댓글 중 하나라도 남긴 회원

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.member_id) AS value FROM (
  SELECT member_id, uploaded_at AS at FROM activity_record WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL
  UNION ALL SELECT member_id, uploaded_at FROM challenge_proof WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL
  UNION ALL SELECT member_id, created_at FROM record_comment WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL
) a WHERE a.at >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 0 DAY

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.member_id) AS value FROM (
  SELECT member_id, uploaded_at AS at FROM activity_record WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL
  UNION ALL SELECT member_id, uploaded_at FROM challenge_proof WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL
  UNION ALL SELECT member_id, created_at FROM record_comment WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL
) a WHERE a.at >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 6 DAY

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.member_id) AS value FROM (
  SELECT member_id, uploaded_at AS at FROM activity_record WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL
  UNION ALL SELECT member_id, uploaded_at FROM challenge_proof WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL
  UNION ALL SELECT member_id, created_at FROM record_comment WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL
) a WHERE a.at >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 29 DAY

SELECT ROUND(100 * d.n / NULLIF(m.n, 0), 1) AS value FROM
   (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.member_id) n FROM (
  SELECT member_id, uploaded_at AS at FROM activity_record WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL
  UNION ALL SELECT member_id, uploaded_at FROM challenge_proof WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL
  UNION ALL SELECT member_id, created_at FROM record_comment WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL
) a WHERE a.at >= CURDATE()) d,
   (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.member_id) n FROM (
  SELECT member_id, uploaded_at AS at FROM activity_record WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL
  UNION ALL SELECT member_id, uploaded_at FROM challenge_proof WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL
  UNION ALL SELECT member_id, created_at FROM record_comment WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL
) a WHERE a.at >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 29 DAY) m

panels.title: 일별 활성 사용자
panels.description: 걸음 수 자동 동기화는 활동에 포함하지 않는다.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(a.at + INTERVAL 9 HOUR, 1d, 0), COUNT(DISTINCT a.member_id) AS '활성 사용자'
   FROM (
  SELECT member_id, uploaded_at AS at FROM activity_record WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL
  UNION ALL SELECT member_id, uploaded_at FROM challenge_proof WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL
  UNION ALL SELECT member_id, created_at FROM record_comment WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL
) a WHERE $__timeFilter(a.at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS '가입',
   SUM(m.birth_date IS NOT NULL AND m.target_weight_kg IS NOT NULL) AS '프로필 입력',
   SUM(EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_member gm WHERE gm.member_id = m.id)) AS '그룹 참여',
   SUM(EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM activity_record r WHERE r.member_id = m.id)
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM challenge_proof p WHERE p.member_id = m.id)) AS '첫 기록',
   SUM(EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (
  SELECT member_id, uploaded_at AS at FROM activity_record WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL
  UNION ALL SELECT member_id, uploaded_at FROM challenge_proof WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL
  UNION ALL SELECT member_id, created_at FROM record_comment WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL
) a WHERE a.member_id = m.id AND a.at >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 6 DAY)) AS '최근 7일 활동'
   FROM member m WHERE m.created_at >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 29 DAY

panels.title: 주간 코호트 리텐션 (%)
panels.description: 가입 주(월요일 시작)별로, 가입일 기준 k주차(가입일+7k일 ~ +7k+6일)에 활동한 회원 비율. 끝나지 않은 주차는 비운다.

targets.rawSql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT id, DATE(created_at) AS joined, DATE(created_at) - INTERVAL WEEKDAY(created_at) DAY AS wk FROM member
  WHERE created_at >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY - INTERVAL 7 WEEK),
a AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id, DATE(at) AS d FROM (
  SELECT member_id, uploaded_at AS at FROM activity_record WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL
  UNION ALL SELECT member_id, uploaded_at FROM challenge_proof WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL
  UNION ALL SELECT member_id, created_at FROM record_comment WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL
) x WHERE at >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 70 DAY),
r AS (SELECT c.id, FLOOR(DATEDIFF(a.d, c.joined) / 7) AS k FROM c JOIN a ON a.member_id = c.id AND a.d >= c.joined)
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(c.wk, '%Y-%m-%d') AS '가입 주', COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS '가입자',
  CASE WHEN MAX(c.joined) + INTERVAL 6 DAY <= CURDATE() THEN ROUND(100 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.k = 0 THEN r.id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.id), 1) END AS '0주차',
  CASE WHEN MAX(c.joined) + INTERVAL 13 DAY <= CURDATE() THEN ROUND(100 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.k = 1 THEN r.id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.id), 1) END AS '1주차',
  CASE WHEN MAX(c.joined) + INTERVAL 20 DAY <= CURDATE() THEN ROUND(100 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.k = 2 THEN r.id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.id), 1) END AS '2주차',
  CASE WHEN MAX(c.joined) + INTERVAL 27 DAY <= CURDATE() THEN ROUND(100 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.k = 3 THEN r.id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.id), 1) END AS '3주차',
  CASE WHEN MAX(c.joined) + INTERVAL 34 DAY <= CURDATE() THEN ROUND(100 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.k = 4 THEN r.id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.id), 1) END AS '4주차',
  CASE WHEN MAX(c.joined) + INTERVAL 41 DAY <= CURDATE() THEN ROUND(100 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.k = 5 THEN r.id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.id), 1) END AS '5주차',
  CASE WHEN MAX(c.joined) + INTERVAL 48 DAY <= CURDATE() THEN ROUND(100 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.k = 6 THEN r.id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.id), 1) END AS '6주차',
  CASE WHEN MAX(c.joined) + INTERVAL 55 DAY <= CURDATE() THEN ROUND(100 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.k = 7 THEN r.id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.id), 1) END AS '7주차'
FROM c LEFT JOIN r ON r.id = c.id GROUP BY c.wk ORDER BY c.wk DESC
